notes.title: Malkin 40% Off During Turn-Based RPG Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/07de4738632f002bbb2c92600cc9a6259c6e497d.png[/img]

Taking turns is fundamental. "Wait your turn" is one of the first things you learn as a kid -- along with the importance of sharing, a related concept.

The best conversations are turn-based. The best experiences standing in line at the airport or grocery store are also turn-based. Love! -- Love itself is turn-based, if you think about it a certain way.

Turns break indifferent, infinitely running time into human units. Pet the cat. Sip the coffee. Look out the window at the world passing by, where good things are always in the process of going away; then look back into that magical game world where good things just wait for you.

When you are ready -- and only when you are ready -- take your turn and say to time, "Now you may pass."

[b]Malkin is waiting.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/7903ff4e8d952e3bb010780681570dc415dd1739.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
This is a major update. It brings a new, challenging game mode to Malkin, a new class, and new music, as well as many other exciting tweaks and changes. Many thanks to [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLszYe7po2j11R7gTJXXX3eLPXG4Ns_IhQ&si=zs3BKFKZLHn6H-hj]Bringitdon's Let's Play[/url] for the issues he caught and the inspiration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/4a7fbc239b2fb9b9c9e4a9ba0d0dea0982e463de.png[/img]

[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Survival Mode[/b]: Enabling survival mode via the main menu's Extras button will keep your character from recovering maximum HP and SP after every battle. The mode also comes with an exclusive foraging system that can help a canny witch survive a little bit longer.
[*] [b]Achievement: Survival of the Witchest*[/b]: If you get either the best good ending (or the best bad ending) with survival mode enabled, you get what is probably Malkin's most challenging achievement.
[*] [b]Class: Witch of the Tabor[/b]: A witch with three lores (Folk Magic, Natural Philosophy, and Swordplay) who draws SP from Charisma and levels faster than other witches. But watch out: they have bad defenses.
[*] [b]Spring Portraits[/b]: Players with the DLC already sort of had spring portraits; now they have a choice between a gloomy spring day by a river and a sunny spring day (but in a graveyard).
[*] [b]Spell: Pavin of the Koi[/b]: An area effect, multi-element damage and debuff spell that targets Will and makes enemies worse fighters
[*] [b]Two Answers to the 7 Questions[/b]: There's one (possibly two, depending on your build) new responses available in the Seven Questions portion of character creation, as well as new connected dialog later in the game.
[*] [b]Items: Grand Philtre, Strings of the Popinjay, Lily Lyre[/b]: A potion that paralyzes enemies and two new musical instruments
[*] [b]Four Songs[/b]: They are: Witch of the Tabor (Main Menu version), The Waterfall, Meeting at the Crossroads, and Witch of the Tabor with vocals (stick around at the Bonnyjoy long enough and you'll hear this one). There's a fifth new track on the Steam soundtrack that isn't in the game, Witch of the Tabor (Sweet Anime Credits B-Side).
[*] [b]PDF Reference Map[/b]: Players can now access a PDF version of the Map of the Woods by pressing M while exploring. (Previously, M pulled up the saved game menu. Now L does that.) The PDF won't give you your current position, but if you just want to refer to the map without going into your inventory, you can.
[*] [b]Tangentially Related Creation of Author[/b]: In Malkin's docs folder, you'll find a PDF map of the broader region. It represents the lands of Dudow hundreds of years before the events of Malkin.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/c4ac3267afca95b689a10bd6276634bdda7f4d7d.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][*] Added a message that triggers after a consumable is used in battle. This indicates that the consumable has been used and that the player needs to choose a valid target for it. This should make it better understood that the player can't cancel out of consumable use.
[*] Spells during character creation and leveling up are now listed in order of cost (lowest to highest). Before, the order was pretty random.
[/list]

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the Fast property to certain items musical instruments and daggers. Fast items can be equipped in battle without consuming the player's turn.
[*] The Mace of the Gold Knight's maximum bonus damage from Strength has been reduced to 0. Getting a free Wallop (5-9 damage) on any successful hit is very powerful already. (DLC Only)
[*] Many mid-tier and elite enemies have had their attack bonuses bumped up to serve as better threats for high-level, well-equipped characters.
[*]Experience rewards have been universally increased. Characters will level up more quickly. (Added May 5.)
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES AND OTHER ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] A tutorial conversation was missing. It's been restored.
[*] Eldest Lady wouldn't recognize a character with Hauntings in two special instances. Now she will. (DLC only)
[*] Many typos have been fixed. Thanks Bringitdon!
[*] Several small stylistic and consistency revisions
[*] The endgame storyline is more flexible (the player can now complete the final stage of an important quest line on the last day; thanks Bringitdon!)
[*] The endgame storyline now disposes of an important quest item if the player didn't do so before the last day
[*] Descriptions for Constitution and Wisdom have been changed to discuss how these things affect survival mode
[*] Added new items to some treasure tables and Sieben's shops
[*] Battles in the cairn didn't have pre-battle advice. Now they do. Thanks Bringitdon! (DLC only)
[*] The Redcappe Knight looked a little pixelated (well, more pixelated than normal) and, I have completely redrawn her. (DLC only)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/cbe21896680bdb1105cadac62cf6062d6535c476.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/864b3a2bf9efb1517e7afe3cd88cd356a90777c5.png[/img]

I've added free summer portraits for all players. Now all the seasons are accounted for:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/36b8044a6beefdad3a4540d4fa1a64111c2b3056.png[/img]

I've also fixed a problem with two achievements ("Watch Out, Mr. Tumnus" and "Wickham Witch") not firing.

Finally, I've added music to the title screen and character creation. It's "The Beast Above the House of Glory," the song that plays in the mountain region. 

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

I'm still working on the four new songs I promised a while back. When those are released, there will also be some new free content! Here's a preview of one of the upcoming additions, a spell called Pavin of the Koi:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/42212a243d0b36c4253daebc00869a1a624d142f.png[/img]

Like the other musical-sounding spells (Ballad of the Jays, Ballad of the Frogs), this spell targets Will, does area effect damage, and debuffs enemies. Unlike those other spells, it uses several different damage types, making it more versatile. It's especially effective against groups of melee-oriented enemies: the debuff penalizes their damage output.

notes.title: Helpful Additions to the Map of the Woods, Update News
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742760/Malkin__The_Cairn_and_the_Crossroads/]The Cairn and the Crossroads[/url] is coming soon. Along with the DLC's new spells, witch classes, items, and creatures, I will add something for all players, both those with and without the DLC -- story markers on the Map of the Woods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/cf958f2ed514d1f96ea4b6d3d5bfbc9c3cf5de53.png[/img]

In development, I at first didn't want the map to have any markers at all except for the landmarks players discovered as they explored. I suppose this is because I wanted people to get lost a little and to be surprised.

But Malkin has a fairly demanding timeline, and I didn't want players to get lost for too long; that "Now what?" feeling can be a bad thing. So I added the blue markers the year before release. Each blue diamond corresponds to a point of interest -- a part of the main quest, a side quest, or just something unusual. Hopefully, this would keep players exploring.

But currently, there are lots of blue diamonds and no easy way to distinguish between what's important for the story and what's just IMO cool to see.

So now I've added red Xs to every location that has something to do with the main story. One nice thing about Malkin's story is that there's no set order in which these locations have to be investigated. For those who buy the DLC, I've also added a yellow X to indicate where they can find the DLC quest. 

You can expect these updates when the DLC comes out.

notes.title: The Cairn and the Crossroads
notes.content:
The DLC includes five new witch classes, a summoning spell, a side quest, and more. Visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742760/Malkin__The_Cairn_and_the_Crossroads/]the new Steam page[/url] to learn about all the new stuff. Below, I discuss one new addition in detail -- zero-cost spells!

[h3]PREVIEW: ZERO-COST SPELLS
[/h3]

These two spells cost neither SP nor HP to use.* Both offer SP recovery -- especially useful to witches who don't have a lot of consumables -- and one even heals the young witch.

*Well, sort of. See below!

[b]CHALICE OF NIGHT
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/12050ed192a6922a1f98690376eb08ffc5eac9bf.jpg[/img]

This is a versatile spell that restores 2 SP and buffs your Wisdom by 3. This makes reaping SP from elf candles more efficient. It's also the only spell that removes the pesky Shaken status effect! It will do 2 cold damage to the caster, though, so witches with cold resistance are slightly better positioned to take it.

[b]FLUSH OF YOUTH[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/aa2bc03d8b46a02cedc01fe0c578f841f8f8fa08.jpg[/img]

The caster of this spell recovers 1-6 HP and 1-6 SP. This can be a great help in a pinch, and if you roll high, it can turn the tide of a battle. That said, there's also some risk along with the randomness: the caster gets -4 Will and a reduction in normal and acid resistances for three rounds. It is, after all, a spell about living in the moment.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 & DLC Announcement
notes.content:
The first major patch for Malkin addresses some bugs and balance issues. Low SP and companion strength in the early game have been most affected. Please report any bugs or balance problems on the forum or by messaging me. 

[b]If you like the game, consider spreading the word or reviewing it![/b] If you dislike it, I invite you to send me a few words of gentle discouragement -- privately.

[h3]FIXES/ADJUSTMENTS[/h3]

-Fixed leveling up doubling some advancement bonuses
-Fixed SP not being adjusted for some effects
-Thickened Knott's rind (+10% resistance bonuses)
-Fixed Vigorous Growth giving the wrong bonus
-Gave Pharaoh +2 HP
-Addressed tomato heirloom (not a typo) not functioning as intended

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/5546f5d46d4f932bbcd8b37a7a7e459169ab2527.png[/img]

[b]NOTE: Some of these changes require a new game to take effect.[/b]

[h3]COMING SOON: THE CAIRN AND THE CROSSROADS[/h3]

More details to follow soon.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44596527/a9251ba54668bee5bb203a6e8f204e6238ef0be7.png[/img]

It may be August in Dudow, but it's fall here.

I've added new portraits with autumnal backgrounds for the young witch -- with a few seasonal costume changes, too. The seasons are important in Malkin, and I plan to introduce more seasonal backgrounds as the year marches on.

Your companions have new portrait options as well -- 1) the default white background or 2) a melancholy landscape background. You can select one or the other using the new "Extras" button on the main menu. This only works for new games. 

This update shouldn't conflict with your saved games, but if you have any trouble let me know!

[b]FULL UPDATE NOTES[/b]

FIXES/ADJUSTMENTS
-Fixed the "Dreams of the Witch House" achievement not firing
-Removed extra blank pages from portrait selection
-Added "Extras" button to main menu. This allows players to opt in or out of using added game content (right now, just the new companion portraits).

NEW CONTENT
-Added fall portraits for witches 
-Added companion portraits with landscape backgrounds
